guarantees.claim: When op_i equals CIPH_FWD or any other value (default), data_basis_x is assigned aes_mvm(data_i, A2X).
When op_i equals CIPH_INV, data_basis_x is assigned aes_mvm(data_i ^ 8'h63, S2X).
When op_i equals CIPH_FWD or any other value (default), data_o is assigned aes_mvm(data_inverse, X2S) ^ 8'h63.
When op_i equals CIPH_INV, data_o is assigned aes_mvm(data_inverse, X2A).

assumptions.claim: aes_mvm and aes_inverse_gf2p8 are pure combinational functions that correctly implement the AES S-box finite field inversion and basis conversion using the provided constants (A2X, S2X, X2S, X2A).
assumptions.risk: Data_o will be cryptographically incorrect, breaking encryption/decryption.

assumptions.claim: External logic drives op_i only to the legal values CIPH_FWD or CIPH_INV.
assumptions.risk: If op_i takes an illegal value, the S-box silently computes the forward S-box output (due to the default branch), leading to undetected plaintext/ciphertext corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: Default branch (op_i neither CIPH_FWD nor CIPH_INV) silently routes to forward S-box computation. This may hide illegal op_i values caused by faults or glitches, and could be exploited to force forward S-box during decryption.
uncertain_points.cond: When op_i takes an unexpected value.
uncertain_points.risk: Cryptographic data corruption or fault injection attack without detection.
